market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month already touched ~$110 in late April per news reports of brief spike toward 2022 highs. Question is whether ANY 1-min candle high in May reaches $110. Given recent volatility, current $104 base, and ongoing Iran risk, probability is fairly high.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the late-April spike to ~$110 occurred before or after the May 1 start of the resolution window.
